control_states.R: deterministic rollback to verified checkpoint; not a generative model

shared_principles: gears are compute/expertise modes, not additional workers
prefer one shared base plus multiple adapters over duplicated full weights
expert output is proposal only until deterministic guard and C verification
downshift on uncertainty, contradiction, safety risk, storage pressure, or missing evidence

gears.name: START_AND_BRAKE
gears.design_goal: high torque / low freedom / fastest recovery
gears.upshift_when: input classified, state valid, risk low, evidence sufficient

gears.name: ROUTER
gears.primary_engine: micro classifier or shared 0.8B base with routing adapter
gears.upshift_when: route confidence above threshold and no hard guard conflict
gears.downshift_action: return to G1 for stricter classification

gears.name: EVIDENCE_AND_METABOLISM
gears.primary_engine: shared 0.8B base with evidence/metabolism adapter + deterministic hash checks
gears.upshift_when: evidence graph coherent and action remains reversible
gears.downshift_action: return to G2/G1 on contradiction or provenance ambiguity

gears.name: ROUTINE_PLANNER
gears.upshift_when: multi-step integration needed and C route policy allows
gears.downshift_action: collapse plan to one verified next step

gears.name: INTEGRATOR
gears.upshift_when: problem genuinely exceeds lower-gear eval threshold

gears.name: CLIMB_AND_TEACH
gears.primary_engine: 4B teacher/reference or strongest zero-cost authorized model available
gears.downshift_action: distill verified result into lower gear; never remain default runtime

storage_strategy.G2_G3_G4: share one 0.8B base; separate small adapters if eval supports it
storage_strategy.G6: 4B teacher/reference stored only if justified by eval and budget

first_build_target: deterministic transmission controller + structured gear-decision schema + adversarial tests before any fine-tuning
